name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 117
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: Is highly concerned by the complete absence of progress on the reform of the system of own resources in the Council since 2020; underlines that genuine new own resources are the necessary answer, in times of budgetary constraints, to finance long-standing and new Union policies and much-needed investments in the EU;
